karats.label: 24k
karats.blurb: Our 24k gold leaf is 99.9% gold, available as transfer and loose leaf books and in heavier double, triple and quad leaf. 24 karat gold is especially popular for gilding projects which require purity and durability, especially outdoor projects and religious iconography.

karats.label: 23.75k
karats.blurb: Our 23.75k gold leaf has a slightly softer tone when compared to our 24k gold leaf. It comes in transfer leaf and loose leaf books, and in standard, double, and triple leaf. Our triple leaf is ideal for all outdoor applications.

karats.label: 23k
karats.blurb: 23k gold leaf is one of the more popular colors. We have it in transfer and loose leaf books, in both standard and double leaf, from Voltarra and from Noris, plus a red gold.

karats.label: 22k
karats.blurb: 22k gold leaf is 91.8% gold with silver and copper added, which gives it a lighter color than leaf with a higher gold content. Moon gold and rose gold are also 22 karat.

karats.label: 18k
karats.blurb: 18k gold leaf is an alloy of 75% gold and 25% silver, which gives the leaf a bright yellow color. Because of the high silver content, 18k leaf must be sealed to keep it from tarnishing.

karats.label: 12k
karats.blurb: 12k gold leaf is 51% real gold with silver and palladium added, which produces a silver-colored leaf with a touch of color, also known as white gold. It must be sealed to keep it from tarnishing.

collections.label: Silver, copper & palladium
collections.blurb: Genuine silver, copper and palladium leaf, in loose and transfer leaf, plus copper rolls.

collections.label: Imitation gold & silver
collections.blurb: Imitation gold leaf (copper and zinc, also called Dutch metal) and imitation silver leaf (aluminum), in loose and transfer leaf and in rolls, with variegated leaf for color effects.

collections.label: Roll leaf
collections.blurb: Leaf placed on a tightly wound roll of transfer paper, so you unroll it onto the prepared surface instead of placing individual leaves. Ideal for long stripes, large surfaces and architectural installations.

collections.label: Variegated leaf
collections.blurb: Imitation gold leaf exposed to heat and chemicals to produce colored patterns, in two colors.

collections.label: Powder, shell, flake & scrap
collections.blurb: Gold in other forms: powder and shell gold for detailed work, cosmetic grade flake, scrap, and mini bundles of small loose leaves.

collections.label: Heavy leaf
collections.blurb: Double, triple and quad thickness leaf, for outdoor and architectural work. Triple leaf is recommended for outdoor projects.

products.name: Voltarra 12k Gold Leaf
about: Our 12 karat gold leaf is 51% real gold with silver and palladium added, to produce a silver colored gold leaf with a touch of color.

12k, also known as 'White Gold', is used on gilding projects which require a silver color that is warmer than silver. It is commonly used for indoor architectural projects, picture frames, and artwork. Because of the high silver content of this leaf, all 12k leaf MUST be sealed to keep it from tarnishing.
specs: Books of 25 leaves each, or packs of 500 leaves. Booklets of 5 leaves are also available.

products.name: Voltarra Silver Leaf
about: Our genuine silver leaf is 99.9% silver. It can be used for picture frames, indoor architectural projects like ceilings or walls, and many types of artwork.

Silver leaf has a bright metallic white finish that can be toned down, or antiqued, by using sealers with color added. Silver leaf MUST be sealed or it will tarnish. Consider 12k gold leaf if your project requires a warmer silver toned color, or palladium leaf, which has a silvery appearance, but does not need to be sealed.
specs: Books of 25 leaves each, or packs of 500 leaves. Booklets of 5 leaves are also available.

products.name: Copper Leaf
about: Copper Leaf is made from 99.9% copper. Copper Leaf is thicker than genuine gold and silver leaf, and can be gently handled with clean, dry and oil-free, hands.

To maintain its color, copper leaf must be sealed after being applied, or it will slowly tarnish. Copper leaf can also be intentionally tarnished, or antiqued, using common household chemicals, which can change its color to give it an aged appearance. Copper leaf is also available in rolls.

products.name: Palladium Leaf
about: Due to the war in Ukraine, supplies of refined Palladium are limited. Our genuine Palladium Leaf is 99.9% palladium. It can be used for picture frames, indoor or outdoor architectural projects, and unique artwork.

Palladium will not tarnish and is therefore ideal for outdoor projects. Palladium looks like silver leaf but can be toned down and antiqued by using special sealers with color added. If your project requires a warmer tone, consider using our 12k gold leaf. Palladium is susceptible to corrosion from chlorine and should not be used on chlorinated pools or fountains.
specs: Books of 25 leaves each, or packs of 500 leaves.

products.name: Imitation Gold Leaf
about: Imitation Gold Leaf is made from copper and zinc, and is frequently referred to as Dutch metal leaf, metal leaf, and brass leaf. Color: 2.5

Imitation gold leaf is much thicker than genuine gold leaf, and can be gently handled with clean, dry and oil-free hands. Color 2.5 imitation gold leaf is the closest color to real 23K gold leaf. Imitation gold leaf will slowly tarnish, and should be sealed to prevent oxidation. Rolls are also available.

products.name: Imitation Silver Leaf
about: Imitation Silver Leaf is made from 100% Aluminum, and is also called aluminum leaf.

Imitation silver leaf is much thicker than genuine silver leaf, and can be gently handled with dry and oil-free hands. Imitation silver leaf will slowly tarnish, and should be sealed to prevent oxidation. It is also available in rolls.

products.name: Variegated Leaf Color 1
about: Our Variegated Leaf is made from imitation gold leaf, which has been exposed to heat and chemicals to produce a gold and blue green patterns with reddish highlights.

Variegated leaf is much thicker than genuine gold or silver leaf, and can be gently handled with dry and oil-free hands. Variegated gold leaf will slowly tarnish, and should be sealed to prevent oxidation.
specs: Gold and blue green with reddish highlights
Books of 25 leaves or packs of 500 leaves.

products.name: Variegated Leaf Color 2
facts: Gold, red orange and blue patterns
about: Our Variegated Leaf is made from imitation gold leaf, which has been exposed to heat and chemicals to produce a gold, red orange and blue patterns.

Variegated leaf is much thicker than genuine gold or silver leaf, and can be gently handled with dry and oil-free hands. Imitation gold leaf will slowly tarnish, and should be sealed to prevent oxidation. The sealer that we offer is NOT compatible with variegated leaf color 2, nor is off-the-shelf shellac or polyurethane which will also wash out some of the color highlights. We are actively working on identifying a sealer that will not affect the color of this leaf.
specs: Books of 25 leaves or packs of 500 leaves.

products.name: Voltarra 23k Double (Thicker) Roll Gold
about: 23 Karat Double Roll Gold is made from genuine 23k double gold loose leaf, placed on a tightly wound roll of transfer paper.

Roll gold can save a great deal of time by allowing you to unroll the gold on to the prepared surface, rather than placing a series of individual leaves. It is ideal for gilding long stripes, large surfaces, and architectural installations. “Double” is an industry term indicating that the gold is about 20% thicker than regular leaf. Double gold has better coverage and increased durability when compared to standard leaf.
specs: Double: about 20% thicker than regular leaf

about: These Mini Bundles give you 100 small loose gold leaves, available in 23k and 24k.

They are ideal for small projects or for patching. The smaller size is much easier to handle and control with a gilders tip. Each small leaf is in its own individual piece of paper, from which can easily be handled. Each Mini Booklet contains 100 leaves that measure 3.25 cm / 1.3 in square. Only available in loose leaf.

products.name: Cosmetic Grade Gold Leaf Flake
about: Preferred by cosmetics manufacturers, cosmetic grade gold is available in sheet/leaves and flake. It is commonly used in luxury creams and facial treatments.

Cosmetic gold leaf is made from extremely pure gold. Most gold leaf sold as 24k is 99% pure. Our cosmetic gold is sold as 99.9+% pure and has been lab tested as high as 99.993%. This means that harmful trace metals such as arsenic, mercury and lead are almost nonexistent. This makes it optimal for cosmetic products. Half-gram quantities for testing can be purchased below.
